name: Coupa
desc: Business spend management — automate procurement, approvals, purchase orders, and ERP integrations with the Coupa Core API.

actions.name: create_object
actions.description: Creates a record in the selected Coupa module (Purchase Orders, Suppliers, or Contracts).

actions.name: update_object
actions.description: Updates a record by ID in the selected Coupa module (Purchase Orders, Suppliers, or Contracts).

actions.name: get_object_by_id
actions.description: Retrieves a single record by ID from Purchase Orders, Suppliers, or Contracts.

actions.name: search_objects
actions.description: Searches records in a Coupa module with pagination (50 per page) and returns standardized fields.

actions.name: add_file_attachment_to_object
actions.description: Adds an attachment (an uploaded file or a link) to a Purchase Order, Supplier, or Contract in Coupa.

actions.name: get_remit_to_addresses_by_object_id
actions.displayName: Get Remit-To Addresses by Object ID
actions.description: Lists remit-to addresses for a Supplier or resolves the supplier from a Purchase Order.

actions.name: get_supplier_sites_by_supplier
actions.description: Lists supplier sites for a supplier (`GET /api/suppliers/:id/supplier_sites`).

actions.name: grant_approval
actions.description: Approves a pending approval in Coupa (e.g. a requisition or purchase order awaiting your decision). Pick the approval from the dropdown.

actions.name: reject_approval
actions.description: Rejects a pending approval in Coupa (e.g. a requisition or purchase order awaiting your decision). Pick the approval from the dropdown.

actions.name: set_integration_run_status
actions.description: Updates an integration run status (`run`, `success`, `fail`, `pause`, or `pending`).

actions.name: custom_action
actions.description: Make a custom API call to any Coupa endpoint (Purchase Orders, Suppliers, Contracts, or other resources).

triggers.name: new_or_updated_object
triggers.description: Triggers when a Purchase Order, Supplier, or Contract is created or updated in Coupa.

guides.title: Expensify ChatGPT Integration: Automated Expense Auditing
guides.excerpt: Automated expense auditing reduces manual review time by using API workflows to flag policy violations against your company guidelines instantly.
